activation: The read-only presentation offers chart only after the actual Village elder meeting. Explicit chart commit enrolls existing simulation if absent, then records knowledge in one final publication. The paid open command alone attaches two native residents, seeds conserved initial local supplies and creates optional world/instance/native metadata. Enter is a separate exact body/cargo/access commitment. No render/load/ordinary enrollment creates destination state or pays rewards.

nativeFactory.registration: Call bridge.register() once before native save loading, beside registerPocketLocation. It creates separate NPC, TraderComponent, InventoryComponent, SafeLocation, Quest+2 Task and Game_Time instances. Definitions start empty/dormant. No placeholder alias to Village/Glasshouse. Native NPCRegistry registers actual separate person inventory/equipment/levels/availability; communal stock has its own native inventory registry category; shop has its own trader inventory. The local shop disables global-day random restock/legacy trade and is served transactionally through Notebook. Native Quest constructor placeholder availability entries are preserved and exact own quest/task entries are registered.

callbacks.read: bridge.read(expansionState) supplies context.destinationNative with exact live revision, real stock/shop counts, local calendar, actual native body form, actual endpoint availability/positions. It does not mutate.
callbacks.stage: After syncTidemarkClock(plan.state), call const destinationPublication=bridge.stage(plan), before validating/persisting. It checks exact native revision, provisions only explicit destinationActivation, stages a single supported native stock debit/price, reconstructs item objects, advances nativeRevision and prepares location/quest/calendar assignments without touching live owners.
callbacks.write: Call destinationPublication.write(envelope) in persistExpansionPlan AFTER regular native/gameplay/ownership/equipment/nativePatch writes and BEFORE validateEnvelope/storage.setItem. It writes the optional native metadata and actual native communal/shop inventory, quest and availability owner fields into the same copied envelope.
callbacks.publish: Only after persistExpansionPlan succeeds, publish standard native gameplay then destinationPublication.publish(), before change_location/render. It assigns the already validated actual native stock/shop/quest/location/local Game_Time, with no random refresh, reward loop or additional storage write.
callbacks.snapshot: In create_save, after all ordinary native serializers and save_data.expansion are present, call bridge.snapshot(save_data, expansionState). Ordinary inventories/person/levels/equipment/npcs/locations remain canonical native save owners. Snapshot adds live native metadata and exact native quest projection for ordinary autosave/export; no new reward or progression.
callbacks.restore: In load, after regular inventory/XP/NPC/equipment/quest loading but BEFORE final change_location, call bridge.restore(save_data). It validates optional binding and restores actual stock/shop/quest/location/calendar. Native people use the existing ordinary loader. Absent destination remains dormant and unseeded. Do not seed on load.
callbacks.nativeConsumers: Existing NPCRegistry.get and createNativeGameplayAdapter automatically bind tidemark people once their inventory:'native' simulation references are explicitly attached. Standard main actorBindings/gameplayBindings and writeGameplayToEnvelope persist their distinct native persons. Native quest pane should refresh/add the actual quest after publish when active; no questManager reward call is needed or allowed for this already paid kit transfer. bridge.getCalendar/Stock/Shop/Quest expose actual native owners to demanded consumers.

existingFileJoins.join: Import tidemarkDefinitions and append its people/sites/powers/commands to existing arrays exactly once. No onEnroll destination effects or controllers; provision:false is mandatory.
Import TIDEMARK_WORLD and register it exactly once in createContentRegistry worlds. No creation of state.worlds on load.

Compose tidemarkSimulationContexts with realmSimulationContexts for scheduler contexts. No independent timer.

Host local terrace/landing changes use realm_move; never expose native connected_locations shortcuts that bypass tide/cargo/access. During real loader restoration honor matching validated saved visit.

clockPolicy: One outside joined played-minute clock remains authoritative. syncTidemarkClock reconciles local occupied visit intervals exactly once. Twelve local minutes: low tide phases0-8, high tide9-11. nextTidemarkBoundary supplies causal transitions. No presence means frozen local elapsed/calendar/people/stock; no offline or unseen absence simulation. Native global current_game_time continues outside calendar; separate local Game_Time is a projection of the canonical visit clock. No auto NPC jobs; already frozen player/resident commitments keep existing job due/cancel semantics and entry/return cannot abandon them.
publicationPolicy: Host returns staged existing plan shape + destinationActivation/debit/nativeLocation/nativePatch. Bridge stages local native owners. Existing persistExpansion/persistExpansionPlan writes one envelope once, validates it, then publishes native state/render. No localStorage, own loop, independent XP/inventory/reward engine or render enrollment.

repairs: Public action preview rejects internal opening/entry/exit receipts; only declared tidemarkActions reach the host.
Native quest tasks use an empty any group that ordinary quest events cannot satisfy; only committed local facts set progress.
Native durable write and snapshot include exact quest/task availability flags and keep the legacy trader closed. Dormant restore also closes the trader.
